vetSays.line: A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "Yeah. Yeah, okay. That's solid."
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek telling A man, maybe 20s about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Jude, Ethel, Carolina and Richard met them at the door — 4 put down. Jude, Ethel, Carolina, Richard are hurt.
🛡️ Carolina, Richard and Aisulu met them at the door — 3 put down. Carolina, Richard, Aisulu are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hannah just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carolina just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carolina, Richard and Tariq met them at the door — 2 put down. Richard didn't come back. Carolina, Tariq are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carolina just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Carolina, Oliver and Tariq met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Carolina, Oliver, Tariq are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethel just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sofia met them at the door — 1 put down. Sofia is hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chloe just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Bilal was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Chloe taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Chloe passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
